patterns.note: Alternating full-width sections with high-contrast dark (black) and light (white/off-white) backgrounds to create strong visual segmentation.
A distinctive, large curved section break is used to transition between major content blocks, adding a unique visual element beyond typical rectangular divisions.
A sticky header transforms on scroll, reducing its height, shrinking the logo, and removing a top banner to optimize space as the user navigates down the page.
Content blocks and individual elements within sections are revealed with subtle fade-in or slide-up animations as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
A high-contrast palette of deep black and bright white is consistently used, punctuated by a vibrant lime green accent for primary calls to action and key highlights.

technique_notes: The site uses a responsive sticky header that dynamically reduces its height and changes its content (e.g., removing a banner, shrinking the logo) as the user scrolls down the page.

Content sections and individual elements within them are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, likely involving CSS keyframes, causing them to fade in or slide up from the bottom as they enter the viewport.
The overall layout employs full-width sections with alternating dark and light backgrounds to create clear visual segmentation and guide the user's eye down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (up to ~3-4x body size) with clear hierarchy, paired with clean, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and card corners, with some sharp edges on larger section breaks.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density with generous vertical spacing between major sections, and a more compact grid for feature cards and articles.

standout: The site's standout feature is its dynamic use of a high-contrast dark theme with a vibrant, almost neon, lime green accent color, which creates a modern and energetic feel. This is combined with a distinctive curved section break that adds visual interest beyond typical rectangular blocks.
